title: Generic enterprise operation request/output envelope
description: The generic boundary envelope for one enterprise operation invocation. request_digest is the canonical digest bound into approvals, effects and receipts (see reference_providers.request_digest_of). The optional result carries the deterministic provider output.

payload.description: Operation-specific request payload validated against the capability request schema.

request_digest.description: Canonical sha256 (64 lowercase hex) over {operation_id, workspace, business_key, payload}.

result.description: Optional deterministic operation output produced by the provider.
